jenna_support: Hi team—Acme reporting big invoice delta vs their local SDK counts. SDK shows ~1.2k tokens but invoice jumped to ~3.4k. Customer thinks no tool calls were used. Can someone help triage?
simon_customer: Confirmed — call from our client only, single user prompt + system persona. No tool calls on our side. Screenshot of dashboard vs invoice attached.
jenna_support: Can you paste the exact request (curl or SDK snippet) and the SDK version? Also include whether streaming was used.
simon_customer: Here's curl we used:```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \n -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-4","stream":false,"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the following..."}]}'```
devin_engineer: Quick look — invoice indicates ~2k extra tokens coming from server side. Two likely suspects: hidden preamble/toolchain injection and a system-side post-run summary we add for telemetry. Can you repro with headers returned? specifically X-Redwood-Request-Id and any X-Redwood-Injected-Tokens header if present.
simon_customer: Reprobed with streaming:false, same SDK. Response headers below (redacted):```x-redwood-request-id: 55ab2c\ncontent-length: 4823``` No X-Redwood-Injected-Tokens header in reply.
devin_engineer: We traced the request id — org was on ff/emit-tool-preamble which adds a hidden tool preamble when certain safety/tooling hooks are enabled. That preamble isn't visible in the SDK tokenizer estimates, but it is included in metering. Also saw a server-side `assistant.system_summary` token block appended for diagnostics. That matches ~1.8k token delta.
clair_prodops: Turning off ff/emit-tool-preamble for acme-corp now. @metering-bot can you re-run metering calc for request 55ab2c?
metering-bot: :robot_face: Recalc queued for org=acme-corp request=55ab2c. Detected injected tokens: 1798 (tool-preamble 1200 + system_summary 598). Recomputed invoice tokens reduced accordingly.
jenna_support: Simon — after we flip the flag and recompute, does the invoice line up with your SDK counts?
simon_customer: Checking — new invoice match looks good. Difference ~40 tokens (client padding/stream boundary) which I can account for. Thanks! :tada:
devin_engineer: Notes/action items: 1) We should add a visible response header `X-Redwood-Injected-Tokens` (counts of server-injected tokens) — low-risk change. 2) Update SDK docs to call out invisible preambles and provide a helper to compute post-injection counts. 3) Add a telemetry alert when injected tokens exceed threshold for an org. Filing RFC #452 and a quick patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/452
jenna_support: Closing loop with customer and adding steps to KB: "Why my SDK estimate differs from invoice" — include repro curl, check feature flags, and look for injected-token header once deployed.
simon_customer: Appreciate the quick triage. Happy to test any SDK helpers you add.
